# ADR template

This template is for new four-digit ADRs. Existing accepted `ADR-NNN` records
retain their original IDs, filenames, headings, and bytes.

```markdown
---
id: ADR-NNNN
type: adr
status: proposed
owner: architecture
summary: Describe the durable architecture decision.
related: []
blocked_by: []
code_anchors: []
supersedes: []
superseded_by: []
---

# ADR-NNNN: Decision title

## Context

## Decision

## Consequences

## Rejected alternatives
```
